mechanism: Rifamycins induce CYP3A4, UGT-mediated glucuronidation and P-glycoprotein, lowering systemic oestrogen and progestogen exposure. Induction develops after treatment starts and persists after it stops; the exact continuation interval is not established by the retained sources.
